scope: Every Lua file under scripts/ and tools/ in the current worktree; excludes vendored Lua, generated scratch/build trees, and private external experiments. Named native routines are call sites, not implementations written here. Helper functions inherit file classification unless listed by public API separately.

scripts.side: server VM script dispatch; invoked script determines effects

scripts.side: peer networking plus local server-facing ghost actors
scripts.reason: Each injected process reads its local PC and creates/moves/destroys local ghost creatures through NWScript. Direct symmetric Winsock UDP; no dedicated authority and no world/combat/quest/inventory synchronization. Rendering follows the engine.
